chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from the one who informed him, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Restrain your tongues and stay in your houses, for no matter will befall you that singles you out forever, and the Zaidites will ceaselessly be a shield for you forever.'
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of staying in one's house and restraining the tongue according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises his followers to restrain their speech and remain in their homes during the period of concealment, ensuring they are not singled out by specific events. He notes that the Zaidites (followers of Zayd ibn Ali) will continuously serve as a protective shield for the Shia.
